subject: MAP: short patch to acceptance window + procurement escalation
messages:
From: Alyssa Cho <alyssa.cho@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance window request + MAP update

Hi Camila,

We're running into a procurement gating item on our side: our privacy/compliance review needs one additional week to complete an ingestion-scope assessment. That pushes our internal go/no-go by seven business days.

Can Redwood share an updated MAP that shifts the final acceptance window by one week and includes the SOC2 evidence summary + a short exec one-pager for procurement? Procurement also asked for an explicit rollback criterion and a list of entry/exit acceptance tests for the evaluation environment.

Attachments: BP_procurement_packet.pdf (procurement intake form)

If you can send the updated MAP and a quick summary today, we'll try to get procurement unblocked faster. Otherwise we'll need to adjust the contract effective date.

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Cho
Director of Product, BrightPath Health
alyssa.cho@brightpathhealth.com
+1 415-555-0132
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cho <alyssa.cho@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-14 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Acceptance window request + MAP update

Thanks Alyssa — understood. We can do a narrow MAP patch to move the acceptance window one week and explicitly enumerate the rollback criteria and eval tests. I'll attach the MAP draft (MAP_BP_v3.xlsx) and a short procurement-friendly summary.

Quick proposal:
- Move acceptance window: 2026-07-19 -> 2026-07-26 (one-week shift)
- Add explicit exit criteria: 95th pctile latency < 350ms on 1k qps perf sample; 99% successful inference rate on the sample prompt set; no PII leak flags on the red-team prompt set after two eval passes.
- Rollback: fallback to quantized model variant + cached-serve for read-only flows, and automatic traffic reroute to a dedicated safe-model bucket if any critical data-handling finding arises during the final eval.

Jonas, can you confirm SOC2 artifact we can share and highlight any data residency caveats? Mina — I'll need a quick note from you on whether a one-week extension affects our standard discount milestones or the credit carveout.

I'll plan a 30-min sync Friday at 11am PT if that works for you — will send a calendar invite.

Attachments: MAP_BP_v3.xlsx; SOW_v0.9.docx

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
From: Alyssa Cho <alyssa.cho@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 12:09:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Acceptance window request + MAP update

Camila — thanks. Friday 11am PT works. I've attached the procurement intake we filled out for reference; procurement asked that whatever you send include an itemized acceptance checklist and an estimated procurement turnaround after we supply any missing evidence.

Attachment: BP_procurement_packet.pdf

—Alyssa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cho <alyssa.cho@brightpathhealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Acceptance window request + MAP update

Hi Alyssa — quick technical note ahead of our sync: we have a SOC2 summary we can share immediately (see attached SOC2_summary.pdf). A few things to flag for procurement so they can close their assessment quicker:

- Data residency: hosted inference for your account will be provisioned in us-west-2 by default. If you need EU-only residency we can discuss a Private deployment but that typically adds 3–4 weeks to provisioning timelines.
- Ingestion scope: if BrightPath wants to exclude PHI fields from indexing, we can enable field-level redaction at the ingestion pipeline; that will not affect the model behavior for non-redacted prompts but does change KV cache size estimates.
- Acceptance tests: I recommend the following quick suite for your procurement team to witness during the eval: latency stress run (1k qps synthetic), functional correctness sweep (50 curated prompts), PII detection pass (red-team prompts) — we can automate reports for each step.

Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf

Happy to walk procurement through the SOC2 artifacts on the call.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Escalation prep — potential credit ask

(MINAS ONLY — internal) Mina/Jonas,

Heads-up: procurement sounded like they might push for a credit if the new effective date impacts vendor payment windows. If procurement asks for a concession, I want us to be ready with a limited one-week credit tied to acceptance completion, not a full billing reprieve.

Suggested escalation note to share with finance: we offer a one-week service credit equal to 2.5% of the first-month invoice if acceptance extends beyond the originally contracted go-live date due solely to BrightPath procurement delays. Any credit to be conditional on BrightPath completing the itemized acceptance checklist within 10 business days after we deliver SOC2 artifacts.

If you agree, I'll include it in the MAP patch and present it on the Friday call as a contingent concession.

—Camila

CONFIDENTIAL: internal Redwood commercial guidance.
From: Alyssa Cho <alyssa.cho@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@brightpathhealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-17 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Acceptance window request + MAP update

Camila/Jonas — we reviewed the SOC2 summary and the proposed checklist. Procurement is comfortable with the one-week MAP shift as long as we have the itemized acceptance tests and the rollback criteria documented.

Two asks before the call:
1) Can you add the conditional one-week service credit (2.5%) to the MAP as a contingency item? Procurement said seeing that in writing materially speeds their sign-off.
2) Please produce a 1-page exec summary of the MAP changes (we'll attach to the procurement packet) — keep it bulletized and call out the acceptance gates and rollback steps.

Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx (our estimated internal procurement milestones)

We'll be on the call Friday 11am PT.

Thanks,
Alyssa
